courseName: SSC JE Mechanical Technical Mock Test

questions.question: Syllogisms: All cars are trucks. All trucks are vehicles.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: Only Conclusion I follows
Only Conclusion II follows
Both Conclusion I and II follow
Neither follows
questions.hint: Conclusion I: All cars are vehicles. Conclusion II: Some vehicles are trucks.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Some pens are books. All books are pencils.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All pens are pencils
No pen is pencil
Some pens are pencils
All pencils are books
questions.hint: Intersection of pens and books falls inside pencils.

questions.question: Syllogisms: No cat is dog. All dogs are lions.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All lions are cats
No lion is cat
Some lions are not cats
All cats are lions
questions.hint: Dogs are inside lions and outside cats.

questions.question: Syllogisms: All apples are fruits. Some fruits are sweet.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All apples are sweet
No sweet is apple
Neither Conclusion I nor II follows conclusively
Some sweet are fruits
questions.hint: No direct link between apples and sweet.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Only a few doors are windows. All windows are walls.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All doors are windows
No wall is door
Some doors are not windows
All walls are windows
questions.hint: 'Only a few' implies both some are and some are not.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Some doctors are engineers. All engineers are scientists. No scientist is pilot.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All doctors are pilots
Some pilots are engineers
No doctor is pilot is a possibility
All scientists are doctors
questions.hint: No engineer is pilot, but doctors can overlap.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Statements: All A are B. No B is C. All C are D.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All A are C
Some B are D
Some D are not B
No A is D
questions.hint: C ⊂ D and C ∩ B = Ø.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Statements: Some red are blue. Some blue are green. Some green are yellow.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All red are yellow
All green are red
None of the universal conclusions follow
No yellow is red
questions.hint: Chain of 'Some' yields no universal relation.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Statements: All rain is water. No water is fire. Some fire is smoke.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All smoke is water
No rain is smoke
Some smoke are not water
All fire is rain
questions.hint: Smoke that is fire cannot be water.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Statements: Only a few books are papers. No paper is pen.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All books are pens
All papers are books
Some books are not pens
No book is paper
questions.hint: Books that are papers cannot be pens.

questions.question: Syllogisms: All shirts are pants. All pants are shoes.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: No shirt is shoe
Some shoes are not pants
All shirts are shoes
All shoes are shirts

questions.question: Syllogisms: Some birds are insects. All insects are butterflies.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All birds are butterflies
No butterfly is bird
Some birds are butterflies
All butterflies are insects

questions.question: Syllogisms: No river is ocean. All oceans are seas.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All seas are rivers
No sea is river
Some seas are not rivers
All rivers are seas
questions.hint: Oceans are inside seas and outside rivers.

questions.question: Syllogisms: All men are mortal. Socrates is a man.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: Socrates is immortal
All mortals are Socrates
Socrates is mortal
No man is mortal

questions.question: Syllogisms: Some stars are planets. No planet is moon.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All stars are moons
No star is moon
Some stars are not moons
All moons are stars
questions.hint: Stars that are planets cannot be moons.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Only a few mobile are laptop. All laptop are computer.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All mobile are computer
No computer is mobile
Some mobile are computer
All computer are laptop

questions.question: Syllogisms: All metals are solids. All solids are hard.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: Some metals are soft
No hard is solid
All metals are hard
All hard are metals

questions.question: Syllogisms: Some teachers are scholars. Some scholars are authors.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All teachers are authors
No author is teacher
Neither conclusion follows
All scholars are teachers
questions.hint: Two 'Some' statements yield no universal link.

questions.question: Syllogisms: No student is lazy. All lazy are failing.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All students are failing
No failing is student
Some failing are not students
All lazy are students

questions.question: Syllogisms: All trees are plants. No plant is animal.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: Some trees are animals
All animals are plants
No tree is animal
All trees are animals
questions.hint: Trees are inside plants, plants disjoint from animals.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Some dogs are friendly. All friendly creatures are loyal.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All dogs are loyal
No dog is loyal
Some dogs are loyal
All loyal creatures are dogs

questions.question: Syllogisms: Only a few chairs are tables. No table is desk.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All chairs are desks
All desks are chairs
Some chairs are not desks
No chair is table
questions.hint: Chairs that are tables cannot be desks.

questions.question: Syllogisms: All fruits are healthy. All healthy foods are organic.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: No fruit is organic
Some organic foods are unhealthy
All fruits are organic
All organic foods are fruits

questions.question: Syllogisms: Some books are novels. No novel is comic.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: All books are comics
No comic is book
Some books are not comics
All comics are novels
questions.hint: Books that are novels cannot be comics.

questions.question: Syllogisms: All rivers are water bodies. All water bodies contain water.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: No river contains water
All water contains rivers
All rivers contain water
Some rivers do not contain water
